title: Consumables BI Engine v7.0 — Unified Stock Intelligence
description: True business intelligence unifying guild storage, the consumes shop, recipe chains, demand analytics, and pricing into a single connected system. The v7.0 approach enhances 6 existing features rather than building parallel systems, creates 7 new foundational components, and explicitly avoids 3 redundant proposals from v6.0. The core philosophy: Demand Insights becomes the analytics brain (not a new Stock Intelligence tab), shop cards gain stock awareness (not a separate dashboard), and the Material Sales 'Most Needed Materials' banner evolves into an inventory-aware farming guide (not a standalone Herb Demand Board). Every enhancement builds on existing UI patterns, color schemes, and data flows already in the codebase.

discordAlertEmbed.title: Discord Low-Stock Alert — Post-Upload Notification
discordAlertEmbed.description: When the GuildShopSync tray app uploads new inventory data, the post-upload hook compares stock levels against configured thresholds. Items that crossed into Critical or OOS trigger a Discord embed to a configurable alert channel. Each alert includes the item, stock change, days-until-OOS forecast, and a 'What to Farm' section resolved to raw base materials.

Alert throttling: max 1 alert per item per 24 hours.
KV key: [stock, alerts, itemId] stores last alert timestamp.

recursiveRecipeResolution.title: Recursive Recipe Resolution — The Foundation
recursiveRecipeResolution.description: The resolveToRawMaterials() function is the single most important new component. It takes a shop item ID and quantity, follows type:'crafted' links recursively until hitting base materials (herbs, fish, drops, ore), and returns the complete bill of raw materials. Every enhanced feature depends on this function.

+-- Elixir of the Mongoose x1 (crafted) --> RESOLVE
|     +-- Small Dream Shard x1 (other) ---> 5x Small Dream Shard [LEAF]
MISSING SUB-RECIPES TO ADD (6 entries in utils/recipes.ts):
Unstable Trigger:         1x Mithril Bar + 1x Mageweave Cloth
REVERSE LOOKUP MAP (new, built at startup):
Used by resolveToRawMaterials() to find sub-recipes by output itemId.

consumptionForecastFlow.title: Consumption Rate + Days-Until-OOS Calculation
consumptionForecastFlow.description: The forecasting engine combines order history data (already stored in Deno KV) with current stock levels to predict when each item will run out. This powers the Days column in Demand Insights, the priority ranking in Material Sales, and the alert thresholds for Discord notifications.
diagram: INPUT: Order history from Deno KV
JOIN with stock levels from Stock Matching API:
- Demand Insights: Priority column in reagent table
- Material Sales: Ranking in Most Needed banner
- Shop Cards: Stock badge priority indication
- Crafter Queue: Urgency indication on orders

postUploadHookFlow.title: Post-Upload Hook — Inventory Change Detection + Alerts
postUploadHookFlow.description: Both the guild bank upload (PUT /api/guild-bank/inventory) and bank alt upload (PUT /api/bank-alts/inventory) endpoints currently just store data and return. The post-upload hook adds 4 steps after the storage operation: snapshot current stock levels, compare against previous snapshot, check threshold crossings, and fire Discord alerts for items that changed classification.
diagram: Tray App --PUT--> Store in KV --200--> Done
to KV:        stock per    per item
guild-bank/inventory.ts: after line ~45 (after kv.set, before Response)
bank-alts/inventory.ts:  after line ~60 (after kv.set, before Response)
The hook is async and non-blocking — the 200 response returns immediately.
Stock analysis runs in the background via Deno.spawn or queueMicrotask.

uiDesignDecisions.userChoice: Color + Text + Count triple-layer badge between price row and cart controls
uiDesignDecisions.rationale: Color alone fails for color-blind users. Text alone requires reading. The triple-layer (color for scanning, text for state, number for precision) follows the existing price source badge pattern (FIXED/AH/WEB) already in the shop. Consistent visual language.

Reuses existing color tokens from the WoW dark theme. Low/Critical match the Material Sales demand banner CRITICAL/MED badge colors. Surplus matches the existing shop-price green. Adequate uses a neutral teal that doesn't conflict.

uiDesignDecisions.userChoice: Enhance existing pages — NOT a new tab on guild-bank, NOT a standalone page
uiDesignDecisions.rationale: The guild bank page is a clean inventory browser. Demand Insights already has analytics infrastructure. The shop already has item cards. Adding a 4th tab to guild-bank would split analytics across 3 pages (Demand Insights, Guild Bank, and Shop). Instead, each page gains the stock awareness it needs.

uiDesignDecisions.userChoice: Enhance Material Sales 'Most Needed Materials' banner, NOT a standalone board
uiDesignDecisions.rationale: The banner already exists with CRITICAL/MED/LOW badges, automated demand analytics, and admin pins. It already has the UI structure, color scheme, and component architecture. Adding inventory awareness and recursive resolution to it is cheaper and less confusing than building a parallel system.

uiDesignDecisions.userChoice: Tier label next to price: '25% off (surplus)' with adjusted shop price
uiDesignDecisions.rationale: Users already see 'was X, now Y' via the strikethrough AH price. Adding the tier label explains WHY the discount varies per item. The parenthetical (surplus/low/critical) connects the price to the stock badge above it, creating a visual story: badge shows stock level, price shows the financial impact.

uiDesignDecisions.userChoice: Inline expandable on click, NOT a separate detail page
uiDesignDecisions.rationale: The recipe card is already a self-contained information unit. Navigating to a separate page breaks flow. Inline expansion (click orange crafted pill -> nested list appears below) keeps context. The collapse/expand pattern is familiar and lightweight.

uiDesignDecisions.userChoice: Inline column next to each reagent, NOT a separate panel
uiDesignDecisions.rationale: Crafters need to see 'need X, have Y' at the exact point they're reading the reagent list. A separate panel would require cross-referencing between two UI areas. The inline column provides instant context without eye movement.

uiDesignDecisions.userChoice: Max 1 alert per item per 24 hours (configurable)
uiDesignDecisions.rationale: Guild bank gets scanned multiple times daily. Without throttling, the same 'GSPP is critical' alert would fire every scan. 24-hour window ensures the guild sees the alert once and can act on it without notification fatigue.

Current data has max 3 levels (Concoction -> Elixir -> raw herbs). Depth 10 provides safety margin for future recipe additions. Cycle detection prevents infinite loops if data is misconfigured. The depth limit is a safety net, not a expected constraint.

uiDesignDecisions.userChoice: Admin configurable: stock level tiers, discount percentages, alert thresholds, consumption windows, throttle hours
uiDesignDecisions.rationale: Hard-coded thresholds become wrong over time as guild size, raid frequency, and economy change. Every number that drives behavior should be adjustable without code changes. The admin panel provides the UI for this.

keyFeatures.recursiveRecipeResolution: Follow crafted reagent links recursively to base raw materials (herbs, fish, ore). Handles 3-level chains like Concoction -> Elixir -> raw herbs. Eliminates 'farm Shadow Oil' dead ends.
keyFeatures.stockMatchingByItemId: JOIN 84 ITEM_CATALOG entries against guild vault + bank alt inventory by itemId. Returns per-item stock count, classification (Surplus/Adequate/Low/Critical/OOS), and location breakdown.
keyFeatures.supplyBasedDynamicPricing: Per-item discount rates based on stock level tiers. Surplus = high discount, Critical = zero discount. All tiers and percentages admin-configurable globally, per-category, and per-item.
keyFeatures.consumptionRateForecasting: Calculate per-item consumption velocity from 30-day order history. Divide current stock by velocity to get days-until-OOS. Powers priority rankings across all pages.
keyFeatures.shopCardStockBadges: Triple-layer badge (color + text + count) on each of 84 shop item cards. Five states with distinct colors. Hover tooltip shows vault tab and bank alt character breakdown.
keyFeatures.demandInsightsStockColumns: Enhance existing reagent demand table with In Bank, Gap, Days-to-OOS, and Priority columns. Reagents resolved to raw materials with footnotes explaining intermediate chain.
keyFeatures.materialSalesSmartBanner: Enhance existing Most Needed Materials banner with inventory-aware demand (need minus have = gap). Show base raw materials via recursive resolution. Add per-card demand badges to material grid.
keyFeatures.crafterQueueBankCrossRef: Add In Bank column to every reagent in every order on the Crafter Queue. Show net shortfall. Resolve crafted intermediates to raw materials. Priority farm summary per order.
keyFeatures.recipeBrowserSubRecipes: Expandable crafted reagent pills show inline sub-recipes. Click Shadow Oil -> see Fadeleaf + Grave Moss nested. Updated herb needs calculation uses recursive resolution.
keyFeatures.postUploadStockHook: After tray app uploads guild bank or bank alt inventory, automatically snapshot stock levels, compare against previous, detect threshold crossings, and fire Discord alerts.
keyFeatures.discordLowStockAlerts: Discord embeds when items cross configured thresholds. Shows item, stock change, days-to-OOS, and resolved raw materials to farm. Throttled to prevent notification fatigue.
keyFeatures.adminTierConfiguration: Full admin UI for configuring all stock tier thresholds, discount percentages, alert settings, and per-category/per-item overrides. Preview mode shows simulated prices before activation.
